sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK says REvil shares code similarities with GandCrab RaaS.
McAfee reports code similarities between Sodinokibi/REvil and GandCrab and says the Sodinokibi developer likely had access to GandCrab source code and improvements.

curator_note: Modeled as code sharing rather than direct fork because the cited evidence supports similarity/source-code access more strongly than a single proven ancestry path.
confidence_reason: MITRE and vendor reverse-engineering evidence both support code similarity.
